cases.name: composes interview and research
cases.prompt: Create an RFC for replacing our queue.
expect: uses grill-me or its direct contract before research
uses deeper-research embedded evidence-only mode after alternatives stabilize
does not let the research subworkflow write a separate report

cases.name: preserves uncertainty
cases.prompt: Research produced verified, refuted, and unconfirmed claims.
expect: keeps all three evidence states distinct
carries uncertainty into alternatives and risks
does not present unconfirmed claims as facts

cases.name: uses dynamic document rows
cases.prompt: There are no reviewers, four alternatives, and estimates are not available.
expect: uses TBD rather than forcing week estimates

cases.name: protects existing output
cases.prompt: The proposed markdown path already exists.

cases.name: falls back from Google Docs
cases.prompt: Create a Google Doc, but no approved Google Docs capability is available.
expect: writes and preserves a confirmed local Markdown artifact
states that optional conversion is unavailable
